issuer: the Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV)
note: The BMV's licence page (read 2026-10-30) says a licence obtained under 21 is probationary, so a full licence is kept from 21; its renewal page gives licences six years to age 74. The ID card page gives the card valid for six years at $9.00 (free from 18 to a citizen eligible to vote). The licence fee wasn't found on the pages read (the BMV's fee schedule wasn't reached), so it is null. No youngest age for the card was read.

sources.title: Indiana BMV, Driver's License
sources.said: If you are under the age of 21 when you obtain your Indiana driver's license, your license is considered probationary.

sources.title: Indiana BMV, Renewing a Driver’s License, Learner's Permit, or Identification Card
sources.said: Six years if you are 74 years or under in age.

sources.title: Indiana BMV, Identification Cards
sources.said: An identification card is valid for six years. ... r an initial, renewal, amended, or replacement identification card is $9.00.
